findingDetails.title: Shell truthy check deletes internal whitespace, diverging from the Node and Python readers
findingDetails.evidence: tr -d '[:space:]' deletes internal whitespace before the truthy case; hook-flags.cjs:93-97 and validation_switch.py:43-45 trim only the edges.
findingDetails.recommendation: Trim edges only in the shell mirror or pin the divergence in the cross-reader test table.

findingDetails.title: Central bypass-switch reference (.env.example) omits the two validation switches
findingDetails.evidence: The git-hook bypass family is documented there; a repo-wide search finds zero SPECKIT_SKIP_VALIDATION/SKDOC_SKIP_VALIDATION lines in .env.example (positive control: same pattern matches validate.sh:75,125,129).
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the two switch lines to .env.example §16 beside the other bypasses, or record the omission as intentional.

findingDetails.title: Upcoming release entry v4.0.0.2 does not mention the validation off switches
findingDetails.evidence: The README calls v4.0.0.2 the untagged upcoming entry (README.md:25); the switch commits (2026-09-28 10:02 +0200) predate the entry's last update (47432cf846, 14:19 +0200); no release entry mentions the switches.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the switches to v4.0.0.2 before tagging, or confirm they are deferred to a later release entry.

findingDetails.title: hooks/README.md states the comment rule without the tab case
findingDetails.evidence: The README says 'after a space'; the implementation and every other description say 'after a space or tab' (hook-flags.cjs:99-101, hooks/shared/README.md:25, hook-flags.env.example:9). Citation corrected from :74 to :71 in this iteration; the finding is unchanged.
findingDetails.recommendation: Say 'after a space or tab' in the hooks README sentence, or leave it as an explanation of the example's spacing.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared the sentence against the implementation and the other three descriptions of the rule.
